title: Compact chat composer · 0.3.6
description: A simpler, focus-expanding chat bar with icon-only attachments and clearer model labels.
notes: The chat bar rests as a compact row with an attachment plus, message field and Send or Stop.
Tap the message field to expand the model picker; dismiss the keyboard to collapse the bar again without losing drafts.
The expanded bar displays short provider labels such as Gemini, Claude, OpenAI and Groq, while the picker shows full model names.
The plus menu retains Photos, Files, attachment previews and existing file safeguards.
